description: Endgame unit: fires when the board is nearly full, most columns are filled and only one to three columns remain open (often a deep, nearly empty central column). Strongest when the player to move is lost or forced (every move loses, or one last forced move). Middle-game positions never fire even if lost; won endgames mostly do not. Rare early exception: an open three on the bottom row (double threat).
effect: Weak. Zeroing it changes nothing in firing endgames (moves are forced); forcing it high reshuffles probability among the few legal columns by up to ~20 points with no consistent direction.
notes: 8 score calls (one wasted by a duplicate run). Best dev F1 0.539 (P 0.42, R 0.75, AUROC 0.86), sim share 0.38, from h9: <=3 legal columns, exact endgame solve, fire if lost (3-legal losses need ply>=31) or a single-column draw; plus ply<=9 double threats. A simple ply/legal-count rule had higher AUROC (0.91) but F1 0.36. Minimal pairs show neutral filled boards (no threats) fire at 12-13, so 'game lost' is a proxy; the real driver looks like board fullness/few open columns with parity and column-identity effects I could not pin down.
